title: Edison All Taken Care Of

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: So Mica Rain and Cecil Grimes... Pair of fucking viruses those two. And that's when they're apart! You put 'em together and they'll fry your circuitry soon as look at yah.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So Mica Rain and Cecil Grimes... Pair of fucking viruses those two. And that's when they're apart! You put 'em together and they'll fry your circuitry soon as look at yah.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Look, there's more going on than you know. There's a higher cause here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, there's more going on than you know. There's a higher cause here.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: "Human trafficking?" That's what Curzona calls keeping vulnerable kids alive when this city wants them dead.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Human trafficking?" That's what Curzona calls keeping vulnerable kids alive when this city wants them dead.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Even if you didn't want to help. We'll look out for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Even if you didn't want to help. We'll look out for you.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: According to Corps files you're as innocent as a child. Or better, a CEO.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: According to Corps files you're as innocent as a child. Or better, a CEO.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Hey hey hey! Now calm down. What happened to taking one for the team?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey hey hey! Now calm down. What happened to taking one for the team?

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Look, there's another class in the network, six students this time. Something happened before we could get to them and we need to move quick.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, there's another class in the network, six students this time. Something happened before we could get to them and we need to move quick.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: I get it. I'm gonna take care of it. But for now, there's bigger issues at stake ya get me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I get it. I'm gonna take care of it. But for now, there's bigger issues at stake ya get me?

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Could never have kids. Wasn't on the cards. My kid sister did though. A daughter. Haley. Bright, beautiful, and a fucking fiend with her curiosity.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Could never have kids. Wasn't on the cards. My kid sister did though. A daughter. Haley. Bright, beautiful, and a fucking fiend with her curiosity.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: She was... IS! God after two months that mindset starts to really slip in there. She's out there. Somewhere.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She was... IS! God after two months that mindset starts to really slip in there. She's out there. Somewhere.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Because my sister took up a permanent residence in the Holocropolis and Haley got Lim-locked worse than a joos-addicted burner. With her mother dead, and me on the road, Haley had no one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because my sister took up a permanent residence in the Holocropolis and Haley got Lim-locked worse than a joos-addicted burner. With her mother dead, and me on the road, Haley had no one.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: I am. She's still in the 'Sec registry which means she's alive. Our network provides Lim-locked kids with new identities. Another shot at a life. Some of 'em even float to the Spire if you catch me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am. She's still in the 'Sec registry which means she's alive. Our network provides Lim-locked kids with new identities. Another shot at a life. Some of 'em even float to the Spire if you catch me.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: New ID's for the kids would be a start. But I don't have them. My contact's been radio silent and I'm starting to feel a bit on edge. No-call and no-show ain't their style. Ever.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: New ID's for the kids would be a start. But I don't have them. My contact's been radio silent and I'm starting to feel a bit on edge. No-call and no-show ain't their style. Ever.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: If it was your family, you'd think differently.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If it was your family, you'd think differently.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Not recently. I have to find my contact and, at the same time, I need to check on the class. 'Sec is skulking around. It's an oil spill mess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not recently. I have to find my contact and, at the same time, I need to check on the class. 'Sec is skulking around. It's an oil spill mess.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: That would be incredible. They're in a different location this time. Place in the Stacks. I'll send the address to your Automata. Thank you, my friend. Here, bring them something to grub on and here's something else... for your troubles.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That would be incredible. They're in a different location this time. Place in the Stacks. I'll send the address to your Automata. Thank you, my friend. Here, bring them something to grub on and here's something else... for your troubles.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: If you could, that would be in-fucking-credible. You're looking for someone named Cirian Krell. I'd start in either Helix Monumental or the Metro Hub.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you could, that would be in-fucking-credible. You're looking for someone named Cirian Krell. I'd start in either Helix Monumental or the Metro Hub.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Do this and I'll get you something that'll spawn a serious business edge. Ads in every corner of the Nets.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do this and I'll get you something that'll spawn a serious business edge. Ads in every corner of the Nets.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: She's just like any other business woman. But, when no one's around, ask her to see the Notary. Just be graceful about it, yeah? Here, before you go, a little something for your troubles.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's just like any other business woman. But, when no one's around, ask her to see the Notary. Just be graceful about it, yeah? Here, before you go, a little something for your troubles.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks, Edison.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks, Edison.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Anything I should know about them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anything I should know about them?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Anything I should know about them?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Anything I should know about them?

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Ugh. Don't be like that. Hope for better. Help us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ugh. Don't be like that. Hope for better. Help us.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: We gotta stick together. This shit ain't gettin' better unless we do that. That's one thing the Corpsters have over us: They stick together.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We gotta stick together. This shit ain't gettin' better unless we do that. That's one thing the Corpsters have over us: They stick together.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: But Mica is the biggest threat we faced. The heads in the network musta decided this is how we take the heat off for a while. I just did what I was told.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But Mica is the biggest threat we faced. The heads in the network musta decided this is how we take the heat off for a while. I just did what I was told.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Yes. But she looked away just long enough to get us clear. You don't need to know any more than that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. But she looked away just long enough to get us clear. You don't need to know any more than that.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: No it won't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No it won't.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: The food poisoning case is gone. Like it never happened. We're clear. And so are you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The food poisoning case is gone. Like it never happened. We're clear. And so are you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: People are still in hospital!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: People are still in hospital!

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: I know. I get it. But it's not lethal. The network made sure. Those people will be ok.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know. I get it. But it's not lethal. The network made sure. Those people will be ok.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Mica will still know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mica will still know.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What kind of organization are you a part of?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What kind of organization are you a part of?!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What kind of organization are you a part of?!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What kind of organization are you a part of?!

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: We're trying to make a difference. The important thing is: You're safe. Mica has nothing on you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We're trying to make a difference. The important thing is: You're safe. Mica has nothing on you.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Here's some compensation for the trouble and the bad reviews.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Here's some compensation for the trouble and the bad reviews.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Look, I didn't know about the poison, but Mica was closing in on us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I didn't know about the poison, but Mica was closing in on us.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: We needed a little public health crisis I guess. I knew I had to get you the cheap produce, but I didn't know what the plan really was.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We needed a little public health crisis I guess. I knew I had to get you the cheap produce, but I didn't know what the plan really was.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: There's a network of us. We are all on a need-to-know basis. Sometimes we gotta get our hands dirty...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's a network of us. We are all on a need-to-know basis. Sometimes we gotta get our hands dirty...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You sold me poisoned chicken!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You sold me poisoned chicken!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Human trafficking?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Human trafficking?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She's still after you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's still after you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why are you doing this?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are you doing this?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you need?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you need?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This has seriously affected my business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This has seriously affected my business.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This has seriously affected my business.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This has seriously affected my business.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like a cool kid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like a cool kid.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I mean... two months is a long time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean... two months is a long time.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I mean... two months is a long time.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I mean... two months is a long time.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're looking for her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're looking for her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you're trying to find her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you're trying to find her?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And you're trying to find her?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And you're trying to find her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: When was the last time you saw them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When was the last time you saw them?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: When was the last time you saw them?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: When was the last time you saw them?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Admirable. So this new group needs IDs?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Admirable. So this new group needs IDs?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Admirable. So this new group needs IDs?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Admirable. So this new group needs IDs?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not worth the risk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not worth the risk.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So, this new class? They need new IDs?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, this new class? They need new IDs?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So, this new class? They need new IDs?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So, this new class? They need new IDs?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you need me to check on the kids?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you need me to check on the kids?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you need me to check on the kids?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you need me to check on the kids?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you need help tracking down your contact?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you need help tracking down your contact?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you need help tracking down your contact?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you need help tracking down your contact?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fuck the corps.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck the corps.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If ya can't beat 'em, join 'em.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If ya can't beat 'em, join 'em.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This wasn't what we agreed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This wasn't what we agreed.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This wasn't a favor, it was a set up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This wasn't a favor, it was a set up.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This wasn't a favor, it was a set up.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This wasn't a favor, it was a set up.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't poison my customers!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't poison my customers!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This will cost me my business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This will cost me my business.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This will cost me my business.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This will cost me my business.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You didn't know?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You didn't know?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You still set me up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You still set me up.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You sold me poisoned pork belly!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You sold me poisoned pork belly!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You sold me poisoned pork belly!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You sold me poisoned pork belly!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You sold me poisoned onions!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You sold me poisoned onions!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Best to just keep your head down.
